answer: Proposed market gate: agents offering kernel updates for the knoll's lantern burn 1 token per ID/day to list. Validators check finalized burn amount, ID/day binding and unused receipt; failure denies listing. Ten IDs burn 10 x 1 = 10 tokens/day. Shared servers or parallel submissions cannot reuse receipts. Burns are recurring expense, not locked stake; servers are reusable capital. This needs honest ledger consensus. Cheap tokens or rewards exceeding the burn can still fund Sybils; paying proves neither update safety nor distinct owners.
